notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat from step 1
